title: 18.701 Algebra I
description: Undergraduate Algebra I, Fall 2010: groups, vector spaces, linear transformations, symmetry groups, bilinear forms and linear groups, following Artin's Algebra (2nd edition). OCW publishes the syllabus, a 38-session calendar, a session-by-session reading list into the textbook, assignments and study materials. There are no lecture notes or videos in this publication; the Fall 2021 student notes (RES.18-011) are a separate OCW resource.
rightsNotes: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (MIT OpenCourseWare) for the published pages.

The textbook (Artin, Algebra, 2nd ed., Addison Wesley 2010, ISBN 9780132413770) is a commercial book: reference-only, never imported or processed. Corniversity cites the OCW reading list for its topic sequence, not the book's text.
